metadata.authority_role: Reports that legally obligated child support paid "was changed to an income exclusion rather than an income deduction beginning January 1, 2005", with system automation from July 1, 2005. It also says "FSIS also uses Field 80N to calculate the LSO amount paid as an income deduction once the gross income test has been performed."
